Small Business II requires ENTRE 101, ENTRE 102, and BUSAD 158 or ENTRE 103. It also requires one writing course (BUSAD 106 or CABOT 105) and two electives. This is likely more than the 8 to fewer than 16 units in this award's range, so it is a different award.
